objectives: Students should use cumulative frequency graphs to determine how many data values fall below or above certain thresholds (Maths 6.1)
Students should interpret cumulative frequency graphs to compare distributions (Maths 6.1)
Students should estimate the median, quartiles, and interquartile range from cumulative frequency graphs (Maths 6.1)

keyConcepts.explanation: A graph showing the cumulative frequency, which is the total number of data values less than or equal to a particular value.
Using the cumulative frequency graph, the median is found at half the total frequency, and quartiles divide the data into four equal parts.
The difference between the upper quartile (Q3) and lower quartile (Q1), representing the spread of the middle 50% of the data.

steps.title: Introduction to Cumulative Frequency Graphs
steps.content: Cumulative frequency graphs help us understand data distributions by showing how many data values lie below certain thresholds. We can use these graphs to estimate medians, quartiles, and compare different data sets effectively.

steps.title: Multiple Choice Question: Identifying the Median on a Cumulative Frequency Graph
steps.content: Given a cumulative frequency graph with a total frequency of 80, where would you find the median value?

questions.question: At what cumulative frequency value should you look to find the median?
questions.explanation: The median corresponds to the middle value, so it's found at half the total frequency, which is 80 ÷ 2 = 40.

steps.title: Dropdown Cloze Questions: Interpreting the Graph
steps.content: Complete the following statements based on a cumulative frequency graph:

questions.text: The cumulative frequency graph shows the total number of data values less than or equal to _____.
To estimate the lower quartile (Q1), find the cumulative frequency at _____ of the total data.
The interquartile range is calculated by subtracting the _____ quartile from the upper quartile.

steps.title: Summary Cloze: Key Points About Cumulative Frequency Graphs

questions.text: A cumulative frequency graph plots cumulative frequency against _____.
The median corresponds to the value at _____ the total number of data points.
The interquartile range measures the spread of the middle _____% of the data.

steps.title: Practice Question: Using a Cumulative Frequency Graph
steps.content: A cumulative frequency graph shows the number of hours students studied for an exam. The total number of students is 100.

questions.question: Estimate the number of students who studied less than 30 hours if the cumulative frequency at 30 hours is 45.
questions.explanation: The cumulative frequency at 30 hours indicates how many students studied less than or equal to 30 hours, which is 45.

questions.question: If the median study time corresponds to 50 students, estimate the median study hours from the graph.
questions.explanation: The median corresponds to the study time at which half the students (50) have studied less or equal to that number of hours.
